[[File:Gg11monorailtrain.jpg|thumb|250px|A monorail train on [[Tamazall/Legends|Tamazall]]]]
'''Monorails''' or '''unirails'''<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> were multi-car trains used on many worlds. One model was the [[Model 10-T monorail]].

Another model, used to transport prisoners on [[Tamazall/Legends|Tamazall]], could travel silently at over 200 kmh. One configuration consisted of: an engine car, a militia car for carrying [[Tamazall Militia]], a command compartment armed with twin turreted [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], a prisoner car (with sliding doorway) for carrying prisoners and their guards, and last another militia car. The militia and passenger cars were covered in reflective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating that could withstand heavy vehicle [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.

Some monorails were ''vertical,'' such as those found within [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
